replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
+1 I like the Map, good terraforming, good hiding spots and different blocktypes. The YML file looks also good. But there is something missing. Maybe add a reward for killing ppl, spawnprotection and you have to define the area, where you can kill each other. You need a duration too, because without it will be endlessly gameplay.
If you need any help, contact me on skype (flo.schmenni) or ask ParaSpider and Evocal (MapDev's).
